mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_variants WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND listing_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT COUNT(pv.id) FROM product_variants pv JOIN products p ON p.id = pv.product_id WHERE 1=1
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND p.ocop_star = CAST(REPLACE(#{ocopRating}, 'OCOP_', '') AS INT)
AND pv.listing_status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND p.listing_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_variants ( id, product_id, sku_code, variant_name, weight_value, weight_unit, flavor, packaging_type, shelf_life_days, listing_status, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{productId}, #{skuCode}, #{variantName}, #{weightValue}, #{weightUnit}, #{flavor}, #{packagingType}::packaging_type, #{shelfLifeDays}, #{listingStatus}::variant_listing_status, #{version}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_variants SET variant_name = #{variantName}, weight_value = #{weightValue}, weight_unit = #{weightUnit}, flavor = #{flavor}, packaging_type = #{packagingType}::packaging_type, shelf_life_days = #{shelfLifeDays}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
